scripts.//build: check:supabase-env runs first so a deployment with no Supabase configured fails the build instead of silently serving the compiled seed snapshots — which is what production did from the two-project split until 2026-09-21.
scripts.//check:supabase-env: Deliberately not part of `verify`. The gate runs credential-free on purpose — that is what proves seed mode still works — so the topology check lives where the real values are: inside `vercel env run` at deploy time.
scripts.//test:screens: The browser gates (e2e/): layout at 390/768/1440, axe, 44px targets, CLS/JS/LCP budgets, first-screen counts. Builds and starts a production server in seed mode on :3100 (playwright.config.ts). About 4 minutes locally (warm build cache); CI runs it as its own job beside verify.
scripts.verify:screens: npm run verify && npm run test:screens
scripts.//: The gate. This is what CI runs and what a developer runs before assuming a change is safe. It chained two more `-w apps/*` gates while CheeseBooth and Sony Live SOP were workspaces here; they are their own repos now and gate themselves.
scripts.//verify: `build` is last and is not optional. Lint, typecheck and the suite all passed against a tree whose stylesheet imported a deleted file — none of the three resolves a CSS import, so the app failed to compile with the whole gate green. It is the slowest step, so it runs after the fast ones have had their chance to fail.
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.//supabase-targets: Every script that touches a project takes an explicit --target. There is no default: with two projects in two organisations, a script that reads whichever variables happen to be loaded can write the catalogue into the project that holds Auth.
scripts.//library:sync: Brings the content project's recipe library in line with the seed: withdrawn recipes unpublished (never deleted), names updated, ColorLab's unpublished originals refreshed whole, missing recipes inserted unpublished. Prints the plan; writes only with --apply. Rules: scripts/lib/library-plan.ts.
